items.difficulty_reason: Commutativity of the Phi/Rf_* square for qcqs spaces with affine diagonal: identifies the horizontal arrows as equivalences (proposition-quasi-compact-affine-diagonal), reduces to Phi_g(K) -> Rg_* K being an isomorphism, and proves it by the induction principle lemma-induction-principle-separated: condition (3)(b) affine case from lemma-affine-pushforward; condition (4) Mayer-Vietoris step uses the triangle of lemma-exact-sequence-j-star, two-out-of-three, and the K-injective preservation under j_* (exact left adjoint) to conclude via P applied to g∘j.
